fm.title: The Personalities of The Urantia Book
fm.subtitle: A Field Guide to the Universe Family, from Paradise to Mortal Man
fm.preface_title: Preface: A Universe Full of Persons
fm.author: Jay Han
fm.preface.01: Readers who open The Urantia Book for the first time soon find themselves pausing at unfamiliar names: the Seven Master Spirits, the Ancients of Days, Mighty Messengers, supernaphim and seconaphim, Morontia Power Supervisors, susatia and midsoniters. The names are many, yet it is hard to see at a glance where each order comes from, where it lives, and what it does. This book was made to lift that burden.
fm.preface.02: The Urantia Book teaches that the universe is not a machine but a family. The gift of personality that begins with the Universal Father flows out through Paradise and Havona to the seven superuniverses and the worlds of the local universes, reaching countless orders of beings. Most of them are fellows, teachers, and guardians we will meet in person on the ascending path beyond death. To know them is to know in advance the home we are going to and the family who lives there.
fm.preface.03: The revelators themselves say that the task cannot be complete:
fm.preface.05: This book therefore stays within what has been revealed. Its seventeen chapters gather the personalities by origin and affiliation. Each chapter opens with an introduction to the whole group and a color summary table, followed by a card for each personality: its origin, principal realm, the number given in the text, what it does, and a quotation from The Urantia Book with references for further reading. Where the text is silent, the card says "Not revealed."
fm.preface.06: All names and quotations follow the original text of The Urantia Book. Feel free to open the book anywhere. Only remember that all these personalities are children of the same Father, and that together they share in the work of bringing us, the youngest members of the family, home to Paradise.
fm.howto.01: Chapter number and color band, an introduction to the group, and a summary table of every personality in the chapter (origin, realm, number).
fm.howto.02: Headings with a color bar gather the branches of one group, such as primary, secondary, and tertiary supernaphim.
fm.howto.03: The name in the color header; below it three boxes for origin, principal realm, and number.
fm.howto.04: Three to five key functions, marked ▸, kept short.
fm.howto.05: When the text lists the kinds within an order (for example each of the Seven Master Spirits), they are set out in a table.
fm.howto.06: A passage from The Urantia Book with its paper:section.paragraph number, and further references.
fm.howto.07: Personalities described fully in another chapter get a short card pointing there.
fm.howto.08: Every personality name is listed alphabetically at the end of the book.
g01.title: The Seven Supreme Spirit Groups
g01.intro: The seven Supreme Spirit groups are the co-ordinating directors of the seven-segmented administration of the grand universe, and all belong to the functional family of the Infinite Spirit, the Third Source and Center. Three of the groups—the Seven Master Spirits, the Seven Supreme Executives, and the Reflective Spirits—are usually classed as children of the Paradise Trinity; the other four—the Reflective Image Aids, the Seven Spirits of the Circuits, the local universe Creative Spirits, and the adjutant mind-spirits—owe their existence to creative acts of the Infinite Spirit or his creative associates. Their domain reaches from the presence of the Master Spirits on the periphery of Paradise, through the Havona circuits, the superuniverse governments, and the local universes, down to the adjutants who minister to mortal minds on the evolutionary worlds. Alongside the seven orders, this chapter also presents Majeston, the Paradise center of reflectivity.

g02.title: The Supreme Trinity Personalities
g02.intro: The Supreme Trinity Personalities are administrative beings designed and created by the Paradise Trinity for specific duties, and there are seven orders of them. Their numbers are fixed and final; their creation is an event of the past. Throughout the grand universe they represent the administrative policy and the justice of the Trinity, forming a single line of administration that runs from the Father's Paradise spheres through Havona and the major and minor sectors of the superuniverses to the local universes and the constellation capitals. The last two orders, the Unions of Days and the Faithfuls of Days, do not administer but serve only as counselors to the local universes and constellations. Being of Trinity origin, none of these beings is subject to the hazard of failure or rebellion.

g02.01.realm: The Father's seven sacred spheres in the innermost circuit of the Paradise satellites, ten on each sphere

Co-ordinate the administrative activities of all branches of universe government
Report to their superiors in the minor sector, major sector, and superuniverse
Advise the acting rulers when the Creator Son is absent

g02.07.name: Faithfuls of Days
g02.07.realm: The constellation capitals of the local universes (the hundred constellations of each); the reserve corps on Paradise
roles: Advise the Vorondadek Sons who rule the constellations

g03.title: The Co-ordinate Trinity-Origin Beings
g03.intro: The Co-ordinate Trinity-origin Beings are seven groups that take origin in the Paradise Trinity: the Trinity Teacher Sons, who are also classed among the Paradise Sons of God; three groups of high superuniverse administrators (the Perfectors of Wisdom, the Divine Counselors, and the Universal Censors); the somewhat impersonal Inspired Trinity Spirits; and the Havona natives and the Paradise Citizens. Except for the Teacher Sons and possibly the Inspired Spirits, the numbers of these groups are fixed and their creation is complete. Together with the seven orders of Supreme Trinity Personalities, the three administrative groups make up the ten divisions known as the Stationary Sons of the Trinity, a little more than thirty-seven billion beings in all. None of these beings has ever gone astray, yet in the highest sense all are endowed with free will.

g03.01.name: Trinity Teacher Sons
g03.01.note: Of Trinity origin but devoted in function to the service of divine sonship, they are liaison beings acting in a dual capacity. Their numbers are constantly increasing, and they serve as the universal educators. See Chapter 4, The Paradise Sons of God.

Judge in trios with Divine Counselors and Universal Censors

g04.title: The Paradise Sons of God
g04.intro: The Paradise Sons of God are descending Sons who come forth from the Deities on the central Isle of light and life, and they comprise three orders. The primary or Creator Sons (Michaels) are brought into being by the Universal Father and the Eternal Son; the secondary or Magisterial Sons (Avonals) are children of the Eternal Son and the Infinite Spirit; the Trinity Teacher Sons (Daynals) are the offspring of the Father, Son, and Spirit. As creators, ministers, bestowers, judges, teachers, and revealers of truth, they make the Deities known to the worlds of time and space; in a local universe the Magisterial and Teacher Sons work under the direction of the Creator Son of that domain. From the standpoint of service and worship these Sons are as one, and their work is identical in quality and completeness.

members.name: Michael of Nebadon (Christ Michael)

g04.02.origin: The Eternal Son and the Infinite Spirit (produced when a concept of the Son unites with an ideal of loving service conceived by the Spirit)

g05.title: The Local Universe Sons of God
g05.intro: The Local Universe Sons of God are descending Sons who, unlike the Paradise Sons, originate within a local universe. They are the offspring of a Paradise Creator Son in varied association with the complemental Universe Mother Spirit, and they carry the practical burden of a universe's education, legislation, administration, and the establishment of life. The Son and the Spirit first brought forth three high orders—the Melchizedeks, the Vorondadeks, and the Lanonandeks—and then, in collaboration with one of the Ancients of Days, produced the Life Carriers. The first three orders do not reproduce, so their numbers are fixed. This chapter covers all four orders.

g06.title: The Trinitized Sons of God
g06.intro: Three groups of beings are called Sons of God: the descending Sons, the ascending Sons, and the Trinitized Sons. By origin the Trinitized Sons fall into Deity-trinitized Sons, Trinity-embraced Sons, and Creature-trinitized Sons; the first of these are not revealed. This chapter treats the seven orders who, after being embraced by the Paradise Trinity, serve the Ancients of Days in the seven superuniverses. According to origin, nature, and function they form three divisions: the Sons of Attainment (three orders), the Sons of Selection (two orders), and the Sons of Perfection (two orders). The Trinity-embraced sons are constantly increasing in number, and none has ever gone astray.
g06.s01.title: Trinitized Sons of Attainment
g06.s01.intro: Adjuster-fused ascendant mortals who, having attained Paradise and the Corps of the Finality, are embraced by the Trinity. Their names are then removed from the finaliter roll call, and after brief training in Havona they are assigned to the service of the Ancients of Days.

g06.s01.01.name: Mighty Messengers
g06.s01.01.origin: Adjuster-fused ascendant mortals who were rebellion tested or equally proved in loyalty, embraced by the Trinity after joining the Corps of the Finality
g06.s01.01.realm: The seven superuniverses under the Ancients of Days, stationed on headquarters worlds and on important individual planets
g06.s01.01.number: Almost one trillion commissioned on Uversa; embraced in classes of 700,000, 100,000 to each superuniverse
roles: Act as defenders of individuals and planets in the superuniverse courts
Serve as official observers of the Ancients of Days
Assist the Perfections of Days in directing the major sectors
Execute missions to local universes and individual worlds

g06.s01.02.name: Those High in Authority
g06.s01.02.origin: Adjuster-fused ascendant mortals of superior administrative ability and executive genius, embraced by the Trinity
g06.s01.02.realm: Any sphere or inhabited world in the seven superuniverses (headquarters on Uversa)
g06.s01.02.number: More than ten billion commissioned in Orvonton; 70,000 trinitized at each Trinity liaison
roles: Serve as administrators without limitation for the Ancients of Days
Present the cause of justice on behalf of the superuniverse tribunals
Foster the execution of justice and the rectification of misadaptations

g06.s01.03.name: Those without Name and Number
g06.s01.03.origin: Adjuster-fused ascendant souls who developed the ability to worship beyond all others, embraced by the Trinity
g06.s01.03.realm: The seven superuniverses, especially Uversa and its extension tribunals
g06.s01.03.number: Over one hundred million commissioned in Orvonton; embraced in groups of 7,000
roles: Sit as the supreme jurors of Orvonton

g06.s02.title: Trinitized Sons of Selection
g06.s02.intro: Chosen from evolutionary seraphim and translated midway creatures, and from Spirit-fused and Son-fused mortals, who have traversed Havona and attained Paradise. After the Trinity embrace and a brief training in Havona, they are assigned to the courts of the Ancients of Days.

g06.s02.01.realm: Uversa and the major and minor sector headquarters spheres
g06.s02.01.number: Slightly over ten million in Orvonton; embraced in groups of 70,000, one seventh to each superuniverse
roles: Administer group affairs and foster collective projects rather than deal with individuals

g06.s03.title: Trinitized Sons of Perfection
g06.s03.intro: Twice-trinitized beings: creature-trinitized sons of Paradise-Havona personalities or finaliters who, after service with the Supreme Executives and the Trinity Teacher Sons, are embraced again by the Trinity. They go directly to superuniverse service without further training and do not leave the superuniverse of assignment.

g06.s03.01.origin: Creature-trinitized sons retrinitized by the Trinity; on the advice of the Trinity Teacher Sons, those of less distinguished performance are so designated
g06.s03.01.realm: The major sector headquarters under the Perfections of Days, and the courts on Uversa
g06.s03.01.number: Almost one billion commissioned in Orvonton
roles: Serve as officers and messengers of the courts of the Ancients of Days
Bear the summonses and decisions of the superuniverse tribunals
Act as apprehending agents, bringing in beings and executing detention mandates
Accompany Spirit-fused mortals whose presence is required on Uversa

g06.s03.02.name: High Son Assistants
g06.s03.02.origin: Creature-trinitized sons retrinitized by the Trinity; the superior group, those of more acceptable service
g06.s03.02.realm: Uversa and the major and minor sectors; they often accompany missions to remote universes
g06.s03.02.number: About one and a quarter million in Orvonton
roles: Serve as private secretaries to the high sons of the superuniverse governments
Act as clerks for special commissions of the high sons
Illuminate deliberations through the single idea they embody
Circulate constantly, serving wherever their idea is most useful

g07.title: The Higher Personalities of the Infinite Spirit
g07.intro: On Uversa all the personalities and entities of the Conjoint Creator are grouped in three grand divisions: the Higher Personalities of the Infinite Spirit, the Messenger Hosts of Space, and the Ministering Spirits of Time. The Higher Personalities form the first of these. Most were created by the Infinite Spirit alone or with the Seven Master Spirits, and they work throughout the grand universe in seven divisions. Solitary Messengers roam the universe of universes without headquarters; Circuit Supervisors and Census Directors keep headquarters on the superuniverse capitals; the Personal Aids are stationed on Paradise; Associate Inspectors and Assigned Sentinels sit on the capitals of local universes and systems; and Graduate Guides live in Havona. Most of them have stations in the local universes but are not organically attached to the evolutionary administrations. This chapter covers all seven orders.

g07.01.name: Solitary Messengers
g07.01.origin: The Infinite Spirit acting alone, immediately after the Seven Spirits of the Havona Circuits, in a single creative episode
g07.01.realm: No known general headquarters; they range the universe of universes from Paradise to the inhabited worlds
g07.01.number: Stationary; almost 7,690 trillion were operating in Orvonton, considerably less than one seventh of the total
roles: Carry urgent messages swiftly when broadcast or reflectivity is inexpedient
Help spiritual and material beings wherever the element of time is involved
Act as personality co-ordinators, helping all spirit beings understand one another
Serve in seven divisions, from Messengers of the Trinity to Revelators of Truth

members.name: Messengers of the Paradise Trinity
members.note: Division of service 1

members.name: Messengers of the Havona Circuits
members.note: Division 2; the first Solitary Messengers ascenders meet face to face

members.name: Messengers of the Superuniverses
members.note: Division 3

members.name: Messengers of the Local Universes
members.note: Division 4

members.name: Explorers of Undirected Assignment
members.note: Division 5

members.name: Ambassadors and Emissaries of Special Assignment
members.note: Division 6

members.name: Revelators of Truth
members.note: Division 7

g07.02.name: Universe Circuit Supervisors
g07.02.origin: The exclusive creation of the Infinite Spirit; they act solely as agents of the Conjoint Actor
g07.02.realm: The pilot worlds of the Havona circuits, the Paradise spheres of the Infinite Spirit, and the headquarters of superuniverses and local universes
g07.02.number: Supreme, 7; associate, 7 (completed). Secondary: 84,691 on Uversa, still being created. Tertiary: one on each local universe headquarters
roles: Direct and manipulate all spirit-energy circuits outside the Isle of Paradise
Assign the proper circuits for spirit messages and the transit of personalities
Isolate a world from the higher spiritual circuits when its Planetary Prince rebels
Oversee the mind circuits that are spirit associated

members.name: Supreme Circuit Supervisors
members.note: Seven, on the pilot worlds of the seven Havona circuits

members.name: Associate Circuit Supervisors
members.note: Seven, supervising the superuniverse circuits from the Paradise spheres of the Spirit

members.name: Secondary Circuit Supervisors
members.note: On superuniverse headquarters; appear in groups of seventy

members.name: Tertiary Circuit Supervisors
members.note: One on each local universe headquarters; created in groups of seven hundred (number 572,842 on Salvington)

g07.03.name: Census Directors
g07.03.origin: A special and completed creation of the Infinite Spirit
g07.03.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, the capital of every local universe, and the pilot worlds of the Havona circuits (they do not function on Paradise)
g07.03.number: Total not revealed; one hundred thousand in the seventh superuniverse, seven in Havona
roles: Register a new will creature at its first act of will
Indicate its death when the last act of will takes place
Report the number, nature, and whereabouts of all will creatures
Record only the fact of will function, not the details of a life

members.name: Usatia
members.note: Superuniverse chief of all Orvonton Census Directors

members.name: Census Director of Nebadon
members.note: Number 81,412 of Orvonton, stationed on Salvington

g07.04.name: Personal Aids of the Infinite Spirit
g07.04.origin: The Infinite Spirit (time and manner of creation not revealed)
g07.04.realm: The central Isle of Light, Paradise, whence they flash to the uttermost parts of creation
g07.04.number: Not of record on Uversa; estimated to run high into the trillions
roles: Assist exclusively the Paradise presence of the Third Person of Deity
Appear wherever the circuits of the Conjoint Creator extend to carry out his bidding
Work without manifesting a personality presence to other spirit beings

g07.05.name: Associate Inspectors
g07.05.origin: The joint offspring of the Infinite Spirit and the Seven Master Spirits of Paradise
g07.05.realm: The headquarters sphere of each local universe (reserve corps on Paradise)
roles: Personally embody the authority of the Supreme Executives in the local universes
Receive reports and recommendations only from the Assigned Sentinels
Report only to the Supreme Executive of their superuniverse
Work closely with the resident Union of Days

g07.06.name: Assigned Sentinels
g07.06.origin: Personalized on Paradise by the Infinite Spirit for the specific purposes of their assignment
g07.06.realm: The capitals of the local systems, rotating from system to system, usually every millennium
roles: Represent the Seven Supreme Executives in each system as co-ordinating and liaison personalities
Keep the Associate Inspector informed on the welfare and state of the systems
Serve as ex officio heads of the four and twenty administrators
Never take part in deliberations on system affairs

g07.07.name: Graduate Guides
g07.07.origin: Something of a mystery; believed to be Havona Servitals transformed after the divine embrace
g07.07.realm: The billion worlds of Havona, which they never leave
g07.07.number: Beyond human grasp, and still increasing
roles: Pilot the pilgrims of time through the seven circuits of Havona
Sponsor and conduct the high university of technical and spiritual training
Stay with each pilgrim from the outer circuit to the end of the Havona course
Witness the pilgrim's entrance into the final slumber before Paradise

members.name: Malvorian
members.note: First of the Graduate Guides and chief of their supreme council; greeted Grandfanda

g08.title: The Messenger Hosts of Space
g08.intro: Ranking intermediately in the family of the Infinite Spirit, the Messenger Hosts of Space serve as the connecting links between the higher personalities and the ministering spirits. Of their seven groups, only three—the Havona Servitals, the Universal Conciliators, and the Morontia Companions—are created as such; the other four (Technical Advisers, Custodians of Records on Paradise, Celestial Recorders, and Paradise Companions) represent attainment levels reached chiefly by the angelic orders. They serve throughout the universe of universes, from the central universe down to the mansion worlds of the local systems, always under the direction of those who rule the realms of their assignment. This chapter covers all seven orders, presenting the Morontia Companions in the seven classes of their work in a local system.

g08.01.name: Havona Servitals
aka: midway creatures of the central universe
g08.01.origin: Joint creation of the Seven Master Spirits and the Seven Supreme Power Directors (appearing in groups of one thousand; every fourth is a semiphysical "fourth creature")
g08.01.realm: The seven circuits of Havona and the educational worlds surrounding the seven superuniverse capitals
g08.01.number: Prodigious and still increasing (almost 138 billion ministering on the 490 satellites of Uversa alone)
roles: Assist in the service of the Father, the Son, the Spirit, and the Seven Master Spirits
Help and instruct Havona ascenders as associates of the Graduate Guides
Act as companions to ascending mortals on the superuniverse educational worlds
Accompany the Graduate Guide in the transit trio that escorts ascenders to Paradise
Apparently become Graduate Guides themselves after long experience

g08.02.name: Universal Conciliators
g08.02.origin: The Reflective Spirits of the superuniverse capitals (seven appear, one in each superuniverse, for every Havona Servital created)
g08.02.realm: Superuniverse capitals (group headquarters and primary reserves) and local universe capitals (secondary reserves); they travel from the evolutionary worlds up to the superuniverse
g08.02.number: Almost eighteen trillion commissions—over seventy trillion individuals—operating in Orvonton (about one hundred million commissions estimated in Nebadon)
roles: Serve in commissions of four as the traveling courts of the worlds
Quickly adjudicate minor administrative and jurisdictional difficulties
Advance through seven levels of service, from the worlds to the superuniverse
Become arbiter-teachers who explain mysteries at the higher levels
After Paradise training, roam the universes as the co-ordinating corps of the Infinite Spirit

members.name: Judge-Arbiter
members.note: Judicial head of the commission, chosen unanimously by the other three

members.name: Spirit-Advocate
members.note: Presents evidence and safeguards the rights of all personalities involved

members.name: Divine Executioner
members.note: The quasi-material fourth creature who executes the commission's decisions

members.name: Recorder
members.note: Clerk of the tribunal who prepares the records for the superuniverse and local universe

g08.03.name: Technical Advisers
g08.03.origin: Not created as such. The Infinite Spirit chose one million of the most orderly minds among the early supernaphim and omniaphim as the nucleus; since then they are recruited from the supernaphim, seconaphim, tertiaphim, omniaphim, seraphim, and certain ascending mortals and midwayers
g08.03.realm: Common headquarters, in groups of seven, on the spheres of assignment; from the local universes even to the portals of Paradise
g08.03.number: Slightly over sixty-one trillion in Orvonton (not counting transient mortals and midwayers); about one-half billion in Nebadon
roles: Counsel all classes of beings on the proper usages and techniques of spirit-world transactions
Function as the living law libraries of time and space
Prevent delay, facilitate progress, and counsel achievement
Serve a special group as law counselors to the Life Carriers
Assist the Universal Censors, the Melchizedeks, and the rulers of systems, constellations, and universes

g08.04.name: Custodians of Records on Paradise
g08.04.origin: Chosen from among the senior chief recorders of the tertiary supernaphim in Havona
g08.04.realm: The formal archives of Paradise, the Isle of Light; some are dispatched to the superuniverses as Chiefs of Records
roles: Keep the formal archives of the Isle of Light
Hold the relevant summary of superuniverse and Havona data
Guard the records of Paradise transactions since the personification of the Infinite Spirit
Direct the Celestial Recorders as Chiefs of Records in the superuniverses

g08.05.name: Celestial Recorders
g08.05.origin: Not created as such; ascendant seraphim from the local universes, received and assigned by the councils of the Chiefs of Records on the superuniverse capitals
g08.05.realm: The subordinate spheres of record in the superuniverses; the senior recorders in the circular abodes around the area of records on Uversa
g08.05.number: Trillions upon trillions of advancing recorders in Orvonton; not quite eight million senior recorders on Uversa (75 senior and almost four billion in training in Nebadon)
roles: Execute all records in duplicate: a spirit original and a semimaterial copy
Make the records available to all beings, from the material order to the high spirits of light
Keep and forward the sponsored records of time and space for the superuniverse
Sponsor the superuniverse organizations of the recording seraphim and supernaphim

g08.s06.title: Morontia Companions
g08.s06.intro: The Morontia Companions are the offspring of a local universe Mother Spirit; they are created in groups of one hundred thousand, and Nebadon now has over seventy billion of them. Trained by the Melchizedeks on a special planet near Salvington and headquartered on the first mansion world of each local system, they are the friends, hosts, and play sponsors of all who live the ascending morontia life. They come in an aggressive and a retiring type, and their work in a local system falls into the following seven classes.

g08.s06.01.name: Pilgrim Guardians
g08.s06.01.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (a class of Morontia Companions)
g08.s06.01.realm: The mansion and morontia worlds of a local system
g08.s06.01.number: Not revealed (over seventy billion Morontia Companions in all in Nebadon)
roles: Associate with morontia progressors without specific assigned duties
Take responsibility for the whole of the morontia career
Co-ordinate the work of all other morontia and transition ministers

g08.s06.02.name: Pilgrim Receivers and Free Associators
g08.s06.02.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (a class of Morontia Companions)
g08.s06.02.realm: The mansion worlds, and on until the ascender leaves the local universe
roles: Act as social companions to new arrivals on the mansion worlds
Welcome each survivor who awakens on the first mansion world
Remain with ascenders until they leave the local universe as first-stage spirits
Serve by need and availability rather than by permanent assignment

g08.s06.03.name: Hosts to Celestial Visitors
g08.s06.03.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (a class of Morontia Companions)
g08.s06.03.realm: The transition worlds of a local system
roles: Entertain the superhuman groups of student visitors on the transition worlds
Host other celestials who sojourn there

g08.s06.04.name: Co-ordinators and Liaison Directors
g08.s06.04.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (a class of Morontia Companions)
g08.s06.04.realm: Extensive areas on the mansion worlds where they assemble their pupils
roles: Facilitate morontia intercourse and prevent confusion
Instruct in social conduct and morontia progress
Sponsor classes and group activities among ascending mortals
Call on celestial artisans and reversion directors to enrich their programs

g08.s06.05.name: Interpreters and Translators
g08.s06.05.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (a class of Morontia Companions)
g08.s06.05.realm: The mansion worlds and transition worlds of a local system
roles: Know and speak all the tongues of a local universe
Teach the languages of Satania and Nebadon
Interpret and translate for ascenders while they master new tongues

g08.s06.06.name: Excursion and Reversion Supervisors
g08.s06.06.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (a class of Morontia Companions)
g08.s06.06.realm: The system headquarters sphere and the surrounding worlds of transition culture
roles: Accompany ascenders on longer trips to the headquarters sphere and transition worlds
Plan, conduct, and supervise individual and group tours of the system worlds

g08.s06.07.name: Area and Building Custodians
g08.s06.07.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (a class of Morontia Companions)
g08.s06.07.realm: The areas and structures of the mansion worlds
roles: Look after the areas and buildings of the mansion worlds
Care for the abodes and open enclosures where ascenders live and gather

g08.07.name: Paradise Companions
g08.07.origin: A composite group recruited from the seraphim, seconaphim, supernaphim, and omniaphim (nominated by the Mother Spirits, the Reflective Spirits, and Majeston, and commissioned by one of the Seven Master Spirits)
g08.07.realm: Paradise, the central Isle; when needed, they follow a defeated pilgrim back to the universes of time
g08.07.number: Not revealed (a temporary, not permanent, status)
roles: Keep company with all who are alone on Paradise, chiefly ascending mortals
Welcome ascenders who awaken on the Isle of Light
Provide counsel and companionship to ascenders separated from their associates
Follow, comfort, and cheer a pilgrim who fails in Havona until he returns

members.name: Reception companions
members.note: Assigned during the last days on the final Havona circuit to greet arriving mortals

g09.title: The Ministering Spirits of the Central Universe
g09.intro: The supernaphim are the ministering spirits of Paradise and the central universe, the highest order of the angelic hosts, which form the lowest group of the children of the Infinite Spirit. They are created in three major orders. Primary supernaphim, the exclusive offspring of the Infinite Spirit, serve the Deities on Paradise; secondary supernaphim, created individually by the Seven Master Spirits in seven types, direct the affairs of ascenders on the seven circuits of Havona; tertiary supernaphim, children of the Seven Spirits of the Circuits, carry on the various services of the central universe. As a body the supernaphim are self-governing, presided over only by their mutual chief, the first angel of Paradise, "the original pattern angel." This chapter presents the seven orders of primary supernaphim (Paper 27) and the seven groups each of the secondary and tertiary orders (Paper 26). Ascending mortals are guided by secondary supernaphim from the outer Havona circuit inward; on Paradise they train with the primary orders in reverse sequence, from the instigators of rest to the conductors of worship.
g09.s01.title: Primary Supernaphim
g09.s01.intro: Primary supernaphim, the exclusive offspring of the Conjoint Creator, are the supernal servants of the Deities on the eternal Isle of Paradise. From eternity not one of this host has been lost, and in large numbers they ascend to become Technical Advisers. Ascending pilgrims come under their direction only after attaining Paradise residence, passing through their training in the reverse order of the list below.

g09.s01.01.name: Conductors of Worship
g09.s01.01.origin: The Infinite Spirit (primary supernaphim are the exclusive offspring of the Conjoint Creator)
g09.s01.01.number: Not revealed (a special corps of primary supernaphim)
roles: Lead the outbursts of adoration and praise on Paradise
Teach ascendant creatures how to worship
Open new avenues of expression to hasten full satisfaction in worship
Conduct the final stage of the Paradise training
Bid farewell to ascenders as they are mustered into the Corps of the Finality

g09.s01.02.name: Masters of Philosophy
g09.s01.02.origin: The Infinite Spirit (primary supernaphim are the exclusive offspring of the Conjoint Creator)
g09.s01.02.realm: Paradise (the southern extremity of the Paradise domain)
roles: Lead the minds of Paradise dwellers in solving universe problems
Conduct courses in the seventy functional divisions of wisdom
Discourse upon the plans and purposes of Infinity
Impart their interpretation of the universe of universes to ascenders

g09.s01.03.name: Custodians of Knowledge
g09.s01.03.origin: The Infinite Spirit (primary supernaphim are the exclusive offspring of the Conjoint Creator)
g09.s01.03.realm: Paradise (the living finders of knowledge are at the northern extremity of the Isle)
roles: Serve as living libraries in whom the facts of the universes are recorded
Provide reference and verification for Paradise residents
Classify knowledge into seven grand orders of about a million subdivisions each
Form the final living summary of the whole network of recording angels
Teach beings on all the Havona circuits

g09.s01.04.name: Directors of Conduct
g09.s01.04.origin: The Infinite Spirit (primary supernaphim are the exclusive offspring of the Conjoint Creator)
roles: Instruct new residents in the usages of perfect Paradise conduct
Stay by the side of the "strangers within the gates" to guide their steps
Enable the pilgrims to avoid confusion and uncertainty
Sit on the triune commissions that examine candidates for the Deity adventure

g09.s01.05.name: Interpreters of Ethics
g09.s01.05.origin: The Infinite Spirit (primary supernaphim are the exclusive offspring of the Conjoint Creator)
roles: Interpret to ascenders the ethics they have so laboriously learned
Help Paradise arrivals adjust to numerous groups of majestic beings
Assist from residential status until induction into the finaliter corps

g09.s01.06.name: Chiefs of Assignment
g09.s01.06.origin: The Infinite Spirit (primary supernaphim are the exclusive offspring of the Conjoint Creator)
roles: Preside over the organization of all three orders of supernaphim
Take charge of defeated Deity-adventure candidates and remand them to space
Designate the supernaphim who commands angels on a reclaimed isolated world
Periodically disperse the assemblages of worship
Provide service experience for ascendant mortals on Paradise

g09.s01.07.name: Instigators of Rest
g09.s01.07.origin: The Infinite Spirit (primary supernaphim are the exclusive offspring of the Conjoint Creator)
g09.s01.07.realm: Paradise and the innermost (first) circuit of Havona
roles: Go out to the inner Havona circuit to work with the complements of rest
Prepare pilgrims for the last transition sleep
Welcome the awakening ascender on the shores of Paradise
Conduct the first stage of the Paradise training

g09.s02.title: Secondary Supernaphim
g09.s02.intro: Secondary supernaphim are angels of seven types, each created by one of the Seven Master Spirits, who direct the affairs of ascending beings on the seven circuits of Havona. The Master Spirits did not begin creating them until the landing of Grandfanda, and half the order trains the Paradise pilgrims of eternity. A pilgrim is always tutored by secondary supernaphim originating in the Master Spirit of his native superuniverse, meeting them circuit by circuit from the pilgrim helpers of the seventh to the complements of rest of the first.

g09.s02.01.name: Pilgrim Helpers
g09.s02.01.origin: The Seven Master Spirits (each group contains angels of all seven created types)
roles: Welcome the much-traveled ascenders to the central universe
Teach the Trinity, the Father-Son partnership, and the Infinite Spirit
Teach an outline of every Paradise requirement
Also serve the Paradise pilgrims of eternity
Commit their subjects to the supremacy guides

g09.s02.02.name: Supremacy Guides
g09.s02.02.origin: The Seven Master Spirits (each group contains angels of all seven created types)
g09.s02.02.realm: Only the sixth circuit of Havona
roles: Directly supervise ascenders, now called "spiritual graduates"
Lead them to comprehend the Supreme Being and the Trinity of Supremacy
Present pupils to the examining commission of seventy

g09.s02.03.name: Trinity Guides
g09.s02.03.origin: The Seven Master Spirits (each group contains angels of all seven created types)
roles: Give advanced Trinity instruction to "candidates for the Deity adventure"
Prepare pilgrims for the personality recognition of the Infinite Spirit
Give each pilgrim undivided attention and whole affection
Present pupils before a triune commission of examiners
Transfer successful subjects to the Son finders

g09.s02.04.name: Son Finders
g09.s02.04.origin: The Seven Master Spirits (each group contains angels of all seven created types)
g09.s02.04.realm: The fourth circuit of Havona (the "circuit of the Sons")
roles: Prepare candidates to realize the Trinity relationships of the Eternal Son
Teach spiritual comprehension and personality recognition of the Son
Teach the proper differentiation of the Son from the Infinite Spirit

g09.s02.05.name: Father Guides
g09.s02.05.origin: The Seven Master Spirits (each group contains angels of all seven created types)
roles: Tutor pilgrims as the most experienced of the superaphic ministers
Maintain schools of wisdom and colleges of technique
Prepare pilgrims for the adventure of attaining the Universal Father

g09.s02.06.name: Counselors and Advisers
g09.s02.06.origin: The Seven Master Spirits (each group contains angels of all seven created types)
roles: Instruct the children of time regarding the career of eternity
Counsel and comfort pilgrims who failed in the Deity adventure
Bring the disappointed before the chiefs of assignment on Paradise
Prepare their subjects for the great and final rest

g09.s02.07.name: Complements of Rest
g09.s02.07.origin: The Seven Master Spirits (each group contains angels of all seven created types)
roles: Teach the impending problems of Paradise residence
Promote understanding association with diverse groups of beings
Collaborate with the instigators of rest
Enter the final rest as one with the ascender

g09.s03.title: Tertiary Supernaphim
g09.s03.intro: Tertiary supernaphim take origin in the Seven Spirits of the Circuits, who supervise the seven Havona circuits and are empowered by the Infinite Spirit to create as many as the central universe needs. They are the older of the two Havona orders. The corps chiefly assigned to the pilgrims of time falls into the seven groups below, each originating in turn on the first through the seventh circuit.

g09.s03.01.name: Harmony Supervisors
g09.s03.01.origin: The first Circuit Spirit (one of the Seven Spirits of the Circuits, empowered by the Infinite Spirit)
g09.s03.01.realm: Throughout Havona (originating on the first circuit)
roles: Maintain system and insure harmony in all the work of Havona
Keep everything moving along smoothly and expeditiously
Co-ordinate activities of personalities of differing orders and levels
Foster mutual understanding of the pilgrims of time and of eternity

g09.s03.02.name: Chief Recorders
g09.s03.02.origin: The second Circuit Spirit (one of the Seven Spirits of the Circuits, empowered by the Infinite Spirit)
g09.s03.02.realm: Everywhere in the central universe (created on the second circuit)
roles: Record in triplicate for Havona, their order, and Paradise
Automatically transmit true-knowledge matters to the custodians of knowledge
Some senior chief recorders are chosen as Custodians of Records on Paradise

g09.s03.03.name: Broadcasters
g09.s03.03.origin: The third Circuit Spirit (one of the Seven Spirits of the Circuits, empowered by the Infinite Spirit)
g09.s03.03.realm: Throughout Havona (official station on planet number seventy of the outermost circuit)
roles: Receive and send the broadcasts of the central creation
Direct the space reports of all Deity phenomena on Paradise
Operate all the basic circuits of space

g09.s03.04.name: Messengers
g09.s03.04.origin: The fourth Circuit Spirit (one of the Seven Spirits of the Circuits, empowered by the Infinite Spirit)
roles: Carry all messages requiring personal transmission
Serve fellows, celestial personalities, Paradise pilgrims, and ascendant souls

g09.s03.05.name: Intelligence Co-ordinators
g09.s03.05.origin: The fifth Circuit Spirit (one of the Seven Spirits of the Circuits, empowered by the Infinite Spirit)
roles: Promote fraternal association between ascending and descending pilgrims
Keep Havona's inhabitants informed of the affairs of all universes
Assimilate information almost instantly by the Havona graph method

g09.s03.06.name: Transport Personalities
g09.s03.06.origin: The sixth Circuit Spirit (one of the Seven Spirits of the Circuits, empowered by the Infinite Spirit)
g09.s03.06.realm: Havona (usually operating from planet number forty of the outermost circuit)
roles: Take away candidates who transiently fail in the Deity adventure
Serve all who must come and go in Havona but are not space traversers

g09.s03.07.name: Reserve Corps
g09.s03.07.origin: The seventh Circuit Spirit (one of the Seven Spirits of the Circuits, empowered by the Infinite Spirit), created without special design
g09.s03.07.realm: The pilot world of the seventh circuit of Havona
roles: Stand by to meet fluctuations in the work of Havona
Take up the less exacting duties of their tertiary associates

g10.title: The Ministering Spirits of the Superuniverses
g10.intro: The ministering spirits of the superuniverses comprise three orders: seconaphim, tertiaphim, and omniaphim. Just as the supernaphim are the angelic hosts of the central universe and the seraphim those of the local universes, the seconaphim are the ministering spirits of the superuniverses. They are produced by the seven Reflective Spirits at each superuniverse headquarters in groups of seven, always one primary, three secondary, and three tertiary. Tertiaphim and omniaphim are technically not ministering spirits of the superuniverses, though both serve as spirit ministers there, and neither is directly concerned with the mortal ascension. This chapter treats those two orders first, then the seven types within each of the primary, secondary, and tertiary seconaphim, twenty-one types in all.

g10.01.name: Tertiaphim
g10.01.origin: The Infinite Spirit; personalized on Paradise in groups of one thousand
g10.01.realm: Of record on superuniverse headquarters, technically residents there, though serving in the local creations
g10.01.number: One thousand for each Creator Son
roles: Serve as the only personal staff of a Creator Son in the early times of universe building
Gain mighty experience as Son assistants during universe assembling
Formally resign when the Bright and Morning Star is personalized
Become liaison ministers between the Creator Son and the Ancients of Days
Many serve temporarily as Most High Assistants

g10.02.name: Omniaphim
g10.02.origin: Created by the Infinite Spirit in liaison with the Seven Supreme Executives
g10.02.realm: Grand universe assignment; in Orvonton their headquarters is a special courtesy colony in the northerly parts of Uversa
roles: Serve exclusively as servants and messengers of the Seven Supreme Executives
Oversee the superuniverses for administrative co-ordination from the Executives' viewpoint
The Uversa colony reports only to the Supreme Executive of Orvonton
Act on system headquarters as personal representatives of the Assigned Sentinel
Some early omniaphim were chosen as the nucleus of the Technical Advisers

g10.s03.title: Primary Seconaphim
g10.s03.intro: One in every seven seconaphim is primary; these are the "living mirrors" attached to the Ancients of Days. By inherent nature they incline toward seven types of service, distributed serially: the first created and every seventh one thereafter belong to the same type.

g10.s03.01.name: Voice of the Conjoint Actor
g10.s03.01.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the first primary seconaphim created and every seventh one thereafter)
g10.s03.01.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, assigned to the Ancients of Days
roles: Interpret the mind of the Infinite Spirit to the Ancients of Days
Make that mind understood to their associates in the supergovernment
Come nearest to personally representing the Third Source and Center on a superuniverse capital
Fill the place left by the absence of a Divine Minister at a supergovernment seat

g10.s03.02.name: Voice of the Seven Master Spirits
g10.s03.02.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the second primary seconaphim created and every seventh one thereafter)
g10.s03.02.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, assigned to the Ancients of Days
roles: Portray the collective natures and reactions of the Seven Master Spirits
Represent the Master Spirits collectively before the Ancients of Days
Complement the individual representation provided by the Reflective Spirits

g10.s03.03.name: Voice of the Creator Sons
g10.s03.03.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the third primary seconaphim created and every seventh one thereafter)
g10.s03.03.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, assigned to the Ancients of Days
roles: Reflect the minds of the Creator Sons of the order of Michael
Let the Ancients of Days know a Michael's attitude at once, without calling him over the lines of space
Supply the Michael voice-flashes from below
Have never erred in their presentations in all the history of Uversa

members.name: Chief of Nebadon Voices
members.note: On request presents the Michael seconaphim of record

g10.s03.04.name: Voice of the Angelic Hosts
g10.s03.04.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the fourth primary seconaphim created and every seventh one thereafter)
g10.s03.04.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, assigned to the Ancients of Days
roles: Respond to the sentiments of all orders of angels, from supernaphim to seraphim
Make the attitude of any commanding or supervising angel instantly available to the councils of the Ancients of Days
Furnish unconscious and therefore unprejudiced testimony from the angelic hosts

g10.s03.05.name: Broadcast Receivers
g10.s03.05.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the fifth primary seconaphim created and every seventh one thereafter)
g10.s03.05.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, assigned to the Ancients of Days
roles: Receive a special class of broadcast messages received only by primary seconaphim
Work in liaison with the angels of the reflective voices
Synchronize the reflective vision of the Ancients of Days with actual messages on the communication circuits

g10.s03.06.name: Transport Personalities
g10.s03.06.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the sixth primary seconaphim created and every seventh one thereafter)
g10.s03.06.realm: From superuniverse headquarters to the outer circle of Havona; inward to Paradise and outward to the worlds of their sectors
roles: Carry the pilgrims of time from superuniverse headquarters to the outer circle of Havona
Serve as the transport corps of the superuniverses, inward to Paradise and outward to their sectors
Undertake the Uversa-to-Havona journey that seraphim could not withstand
Take on energy for flight in transit and recuperate at journey's end

g10.s03.07.name: Reserve Corps
g10.s03.07.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the seventh primary seconaphim created and every seventh one thereafter)
g10.s03.07.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, assigned to the Ancients of Days
g10.s03.07.number: A very large group (exact number not revealed)
roles: Take the unclassified duties and emergency assignments of the realms
Fill in for their specialized fellows, but only in emergencies
Perform the generalized superuniverse duties outside the scope of angels of specific assignment

g10.s04.title: Secondary Seconaphim
g10.s04.intro: Secondary seconaphim are no less reflective than the primary; the terms primary, secondary, and tertiary denote order of procedure, not status. Their seven types serve the Trinity-origin associates of the Ancients of Days: three are attached to the Perfectors of Wisdom, three to the Divine Counselors, and one to the Universal Censors.

g10.s04.01.name: Voice of Wisdom
g10.s04.01.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the first type of secondary seconaphim, created serially every seventh)
g10.s04.01.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, attached to the Perfectors of Wisdom (special receiving chambers of the temple of wisdom on Uversa)
roles: Maintain perpetual liaison with the living libraries of Paradise
Segregate the essence of wisdom from the information on the master circuits
Transmit that wisdom unerringly to the Perfectors of Wisdom
Draw both divine wisdom from above and practical wisdom from below

g10.s04.02.name: Soul of Philosophy
g10.s04.02.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the second type of secondary seconaphim, created serially every seventh)
g10.s04.02.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, attached to the Perfectors of Wisdom
roles: Remain in focal synchrony with the masters of philosophy on Paradise
Reflect, like living mirrors, the wisdom of divinity and the philosophy of Paradise
Dilute that philosophy to the needs of lowly worlds by turning their faces downward
Help the Perfectors of Wisdom fit decisions to actual needs

g10.s04.03.name: Union of Souls
g10.s04.03.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the third type of secondary seconaphim, created serially every seventh)
g10.s04.03.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, attached to the Perfectors of Wisdom
roles: Reflect the ideals and status of ethical relationships
Help resolve the petty frictions and misunderstandings among intelligent beings
Supply current universe information together with the Paradise ideal of adjustment
Keep reflective liaison with the interpreters of ethics on Paradise
Foster the teamwork of all Orvonton

g10.s04.04.name: Heart of Counsel
g10.s04.04.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the fourth type of secondary seconaphim, created serially every seventh)
g10.s04.04.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, attached to the Divine Counselors
roles: Possess the facts of space, selected from the circuits of time
Especially reflect the superaphic intelligence co-ordinators
Selectively reflect the counsel of all beings, high or low
Let the rulings of the Divine Counselors embody the counsel of the whole superuniverse

g10.s04.05.name: Joy of Existence
g10.s04.05.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the fifth type of secondary seconaphim, created serially every seventh)
g10.s04.05.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, attached to the Divine Counselors
roles: Are reflectively attuned to the superaphic harmony supervisors and certain seraphim
Promote reactions of joy among angels and the lower will creatures
Function as joy clearinghouses in collaboration with the reversion directors
Try to improve the humor taste and develop a superhumor
Seek to show that there is inherent joy in freewill existence

g10.s04.06.name: Satisfaction of Service
g10.s04.06.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the sixth type of secondary seconaphim, created serially every seventh)
g10.s04.06.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, attached to the Divine Counselors
roles: Reflect the attitude of the directors of conduct on Paradise
Enhance the value of service and the satisfaction it brings
Reflect the benefits of spiritual service from world to world
Use the performance of the best to inspire the mediocre
Promote a wholesome fraternal rivalry

g10.s04.07.name: Discerner of Spirits
g10.s04.07.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the seventh type of secondary seconaphim, created serially every seventh)
g10.s04.07.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, attached to the Universal Censors and accompanying them on every mission away from Uversa
roles: Disclose at once the true motive, purpose, and origin of any information
Unerringly reflect the actual moral and spiritual character of an individual
Enable the Censors to judge as righteous judges
Report "what manner of spirit" has been born on the worlds of space
Reflect the presence of Adjusters but cannot decipher their mindedness

g10.s05.title: Tertiary Seconaphim
g10.s05.intro: Tertiary seconaphim are likewise created serially in seven reflective types, but rather than being assigned type by type, they serve collectively and interchangeably under the Trinitized Sons of Attainment: the Mighty Messengers, Those High in Authority, and Those without Name and Number. Of the three orders of seconaphim, they minister most extensively to the ascending creatures of time.

g10.s05.01.name: Significance of Origins
g10.s05.01.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the first type of tertiary seconaphim, created serially)
g10.s05.01.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, collectively assigned to the Trinitized Sons of Attainment; they also minister widely to ascenders
roles: Instantly portray whatever is required about the origin of any individual, race, or world
Serve as living ready-reference genealogies of the superuniverse hosts
Supply up-to-the-minute estimates of ancestry and current status
Teach ascenders how to apply spirit ethics

g10.s05.02.name: Memory of Mercy
g10.s05.02.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the second type of tertiary seconaphim, created serially)
g10.s05.02.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, collectively assigned to the Trinitized Sons of Attainment; they also minister widely to ascenders
roles: Keep the living records of mercy extended to individuals and races
Set spiritual liabilities against the assets of the saving provision
Testify in the courts of Uversa when the right to unending life is adjudicated
Teach ascenders how to be truly merciful

g10.s05.03.name: Import of Time
g10.s05.03.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the third type of tertiary seconaphim, created serially)
g10.s05.03.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, collectively assigned to the Trinitized Sons of Attainment; they also minister widely to ascenders
roles: Give counsel on time in the assignment of trusts
Testify that every defendant has had ample time for decision
Portray the time required to complete any undertaking
Enable the ascendant authorities to forecast future events
Teach on the mansion worlds the use of time in work and rest

g10.s05.04.name: Solemnity of Trust
g10.s05.04.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the fourth type of tertiary seconaphim, created serially)
g10.s05.04.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, assigned to the Trinitized Sons of Attainment; they always accompany Those High in Authority
roles: Portray to will creatures the obligation, sacredness, and solemnity of trust
Reflect to the governing authorities the exact trustworthiness of any candidate
Prevent the mistake of placing responsibility prematurely
Accompany Those High in Authority, weighing candidates before any assignment

g10.s05.05.name: Sanctity of Service
g10.s05.05.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the fifth type of tertiary seconaphim, created serially)
g10.s05.05.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, collectively assigned to the Trinitized Sons of Attainment; they also minister widely to ascenders
roles: Reveal in their faces the real nature of any service
Show a full analysis of true and hidden motives
Lay bare the deep motives of the human heart and the angelic mind

g10.s05.06.name: Secret of Greatness
g10.s05.06.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the sixth type of tertiary seconaphim, created serially)
g10.s05.06.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, collectively assigned to the Trinitized Sons of Attainment; they also minister widely to ascenders
roles: Reflectively estimate the greatness of beings
Gauge greatness by the content of goodness
Work with the Soul of Goodness, rendering a dual, interdependent report

g10.s05.07.name: Soul of Goodness
g10.s05.07.origin: The seven Reflective Spirits of a superuniverse headquarters (the seventh type of tertiary seconaphim, created serially)
g10.s05.07.realm: Superuniverse headquarters, collectively assigned to the Trinitized Sons of Attainment; they also minister widely to ascenders
roles: Reflectively estimate the goodness of beings
Portray goodness together with its inherent divine greatness
Work with the Secret of Greatness, rendering a dual, interdependent report

g11.title: The Universe Power Directors
g11.intro: The Universe Power Directors are living beings who intelligently regulate physical energy throughout the grand universe. The Seven Master Spirits created the Seven Supreme Power Directors; these in turn, together with the Master Spirits, produced the Supreme Power Centers, whose direct offspring are the Master Physical Controllers. They deal only with power—material or semiphysical energy—which they do not originate but modify, manipulate, and directionize. Power centers and physical controllers are created perfect and undergo no training or evolution; the Supreme Power Directors and all their subordinates are exempt from interference by the tribunals of space and are not subject to the administrative direction of superuniverse or local universe governments. This chapter covers the Seven Supreme Power Directors, the Morontia Power Supervisors of the local universes, the seven groups each of power centers and physical controllers, and the Master Force Organizers who precede them in outer space.

g11.01.name: Seven Supreme Power Directors
g11.01.origin: The Seven Master Spirits acting collectively (the first recorded semimaterial progeny of true spirit ancestry)
g11.01.realm: Peripheral Paradise, marking the force-focal headquarters of the Master Spirits
roles: Regulate the physical energy of the grand universe
Act singly for the superuniverses, collectively for the central creation
Create the Supreme Power Centers together with the Master Spirits
Govern the Master Physical Controllers as far as superuniverse headquarters
Each work in eternal union with one Master Spirit

g11.s02.title: Morontia Power Supervisors
g11.s02.intro: Offspring of a local universe Mother Spirit, they are the channels of morontia power that make possible the transition environment of morontia progression. The first are created when the first mortal survivor arrives on a mansion world, and they are created in groups of one thousand in seven classes. Directed only by the joint activity of the Universe Son and Universe Spirit, they are otherwise self-governing and keep headquarters on the first mansion world of each local system.

g11.s02.01.name: Circuit Regulators
g11.s02.01.origin: A local universe Mother Spirit (one class of the Morontia Power Supervisors)
g11.s02.01.realm: The transition (morontia) spheres; each circuit is limited to a single world
g11.s02.01.number: 400 in each group of 1,000 (millions are needed for the Satania mansion worlds alone)
roles: Co-ordinate physical and spiritual energy
Regulate its flow into the segregated channels of the morontia spheres
As morontia power generators, transform space energies into morontia materials
Change material energies so that their associates can control them

g11.s02.02.name: System Co-ordinators
g11.s02.02.origin: A local universe Mother Spirit (one class of the Morontia Power Supervisors)
g11.s02.02.realm: The mansion worlds and other morontia transition spheres
roles: Harmonize the differing power systems of each world into a working unit
Receive ascenders delivered to the next sphere
Effect the changes in creature form in the chambers of transition (about seven days)

g11.s02.03.name: Planetary Custodians
g11.s02.03.origin: A local universe Mother Spirit (one class of the Morontia Power Supervisors)
g11.s02.03.realm: Every morontia world from the mansion spheres up to the universe headquarters
g11.s02.03.number: 100 in each group of 1,000 (seventy guardians on each morontia world)
roles: Hold custody of the morontia affairs of each morontia world
Constitute the local planetary council of supreme morontia authority
Grant material for morontia forms to arriving ascenders
Authorize the changes in form that let an ascender proceed to the next sphere

g11.s02.04.name: Combined Controllers
g11.s02.04.origin: A local universe Mother Spirit (one class of the Morontia Power Supervisors)
g11.s02.04.realm: The center of each administrative unit of a morontia world
g11.s02.04.number: 100 in each group of 1,000 (one in each administrative unit)
roles: Sense and function with physical, spiritual, and morontial energies
Serve as the center of a working team of other power supervisors in each unit

members.name: Makeup of a team
members.note: One combined controller with two system co-ordinators, four circuit regulators, one planetary custodian, one liaison stabilizer, and either an associate registrar or a selective assorter

g11.s02.05.name: Liaison Stabilizers
g11.s02.05.origin: A local universe Mother Spirit (one class of the Morontia Power Supervisors)
roles: Regulate morontia energy in association with physical and spirit forces
Make possible the conversion of morontia energy into morontia material
Slow down energy revolutions to the point where physicalization can occur

g11.s02.06.name: Selective Assorters
g11.s02.06.origin: A local universe Mother Spirit (one class of the Morontia Power Supervisors)
roles: Re-key or advance-tune ascenders moving to a new phase
Keep them in progressive synchrony with morontia life
Examine spiritual achievement and certify advanced standing
Group morontia personalities for study, teaching, and other projects

g11.s02.07.name: Associate Registrars
g11.s02.07.origin: A local universe Mother Spirit (one class of the Morontia Power Supervisors)
roles: Serve as the recorders of the morontia world
Supervise and keep morontia records in association with the spirit recorders

g11.s03.title: Supreme Power Centers
g11.s03.intro: Created by the Seven Supreme Power Directors in association with the Seven Master Spirits, they number with their associates and subordinates upward of ten billion. Endowed with Third-Source personality and high volition, they are the intellect of the power system of the grand universe. Outside Havona they function only on architectural spheres or suitably constituted space bodies, and they serve in seven groups.

g11.s03.01.name: Supreme Center Supervisors
g11.s03.01.origin: Created collectively by the Seven Supreme Power Directors in association with the Seven Master Spirits
g11.s03.01.realm: The special worlds of the Seven Supreme Executives, one headquarters on each
roles: Regulate the master energy circuits of the grand universe
Work in close association with the Seven Supreme Executives
With the Supreme Power Directors, deal with all phenomena below "gravity energy"
Create the energy transformers jointly with the Supreme Power Directors

g11.s03.02.name: Havona Centers
g11.s03.02.origin: Created collectively by the Seven Supreme Power Directors in association with the Seven Master Spirits
roles: Each supervise a thousand Havona worlds
Maintain the perfection of energy control found only in Havona

g11.s03.03.name: Superuniverse Centers
g11.s03.03.origin: Created collectively by the Seven Supreme Power Directors in association with the Seven Master Spirits
g11.s03.03.realm: The capital sphere of each of the seven superuniverses
roles: Receive the three currents of primary energy of ten segregations each
Send forth seven specialized circuits of power
Constitute the electronic organization of universe power

g11.s03.04.name: Local Universe Centers
g11.s03.04.origin: Created collectively by the Seven Supreme Power Directors in association with the Seven Master Spirits
g11.s03.04.realm: The headquarters of each local universe (in Nebadon, the exact energy center of Salvington)
roles: Downstep and modify the seven power circuits from the superuniverse
Dispatch effective energy to the constellations and systems
Assist the Creator Sons in the later times of universe organization
Provide energy lanes for interplanetary communication

g11.s03.05.name: Constellation Centers
g11.s03.05.origin: Created collectively by the Seven Supreme Power Directors in association with the Seven Master Spirits
g11.s03.05.realm: Each constellation (in Norlatiadek, at the center of the stellar system forming the constellation's physical core)
roles: Project energy to the one hundred tributary local systems
Send forth power lines for communication and transport
Energize creatures who depend on physical energy to sustain life

g11.s03.06.name: System Centers
g11.s03.06.origin: Created collectively by the Seven Supreme Power Directors in association with the Seven Master Spirits
g11.s03.06.realm: The exact gravity focus of each local system (in Satania, a dark island at the astronomic center)
roles: Dispatch the power circuits to the inhabited worlds
Co-ordinate the activities of the subordinate physical controllers
Insure the satisfactory distribution of power in the local system
Link the higher centers with the controllers on evolutionary planets

g11.s03.07.name: Unclassified Centers
g11.s03.07.origin: Created collectively by the Seven Supreme Power Directors in association with the Seven Master Spirits
g11.s03.07.realm: Special spheres of the most extraordinary energy relationships (never the inhabited planets)
g11.s03.07.number: Not revealed (found on fewer than one space body in a million)
roles: Function in special local situations
Act as universe balance wheels or energy governors

g11.s04.title: Master Physical Controllers
g11.s04.intro: The direct offspring and mobile subordinates of the Supreme Power Centers, they serve throughout the grand universe. As far as superuniverse headquarters they are governed directly by the Seven Supreme Power Directors; from there the Council of Equilibrium directs and distributes them. Of their seven orders the last four react wholly automatically and are hardly persons, yet all are intelligent.

g11.s04.01.name: Associate Power Directors
g11.s04.01.origin: The Supreme Power Centers (the Master Physical Controllers are their direct offspring)
g11.s04.01.realm: The headquarters worlds of the minor sectors (with an inspector on every local system capital)
g11.s04.01.number: 3 million in each Orvonton minor sector; 3 billion in the superuniverse
roles: Assign and dispatch all orders of physical controllers
Teach all who study the sciences of energy control
Alternate executive service with inspection tours of space
Keep the whole living energy aggregation in harmonious synchrony

g11.s04.02.name: Mechanical Controllers
g11.s04.02.origin: The Supreme Power Centers (the Master Physical Controllers are their direct offspring)
g11.s04.02.realm: From the minor sectors to the inhabited worlds (including Urantia)
g11.s04.02.number: Trillions upon trillions in the minor sector of Ensa; 10 on Urantia
roles: Serve as mobile assistants of the associate power directors
Facilitate the departure of seraphic transports
Directionize energy and concentrate it into circuits
Equalize the pressures of the interplanetary circuits

g11.s04.03.name: Energy Transformers
g11.s04.03.origin: Conjoint creation of the Seven Supreme Power Directors and the Seven Center Supervisors
g11.s04.03.number: Almost one million in Satania alone; usually 100 on each inhabited world
roles: Command on a planet when no associate power director is present
Inspect all departing seraphic transports
As living switches, insulate planets against powerful energy streams
Maintain universal energy balance
Change the form of twenty-seven of the thirty physical energies

g11.s04.04.name: Energy Transmitters
g11.s04.04.origin: The Supreme Power Centers (the Master Physical Controllers are their direct offspring)
g11.s04.04.realm: Chiefly within individual planets (also in the local systems)
g11.s04.04.number: Not revealed (a battery of one thousand assists a seraphic departure)
roles: Dispatch energy as it is manifested on the individual worlds
Line up along a path to induce energy flow into a new circuit
Detect and augment weakening communication currents
Provide emergency lines of communication
Help sustain mortal life on worlds with an impoverished atmosphere

g11.s04.05.name: Primary Associators
g11.s04.05.origin: The Supreme Power Centers (the Master Physical Controllers are their direct offspring)
g11.s04.05.realm: Organizing material spheres, where they are the first group of life to appear
roles: Store energy during times of plus manifestations
Release the accumulated energy during seasons of minus manifestations
Convert space energies as far as the primitive units of matter
Act by their mere presence, like living catalytic agents

g11.s04.06.name: Secondary Dissociators
g11.s04.06.origin: The Supreme Power Centers (the Master Physical Controllers are their direct offspring)
g11.s04.06.realm: The local worlds and local systems
roles: Work in reverse of the primary associators
Evolve limitless supplies of energy out of matter
Ensure that special forms of physical energy are never exhausted locally

g11.s04.07.name: Frandalanks and Chronoldeks
g11.s04.07.origin: Joint creation of all three orders of energy-control beings: the primary and secondary force organizers and the power directors
g11.s04.07.realm: All inhabited worlds; they also function in the central and superuniverses and in outer space
g11.s04.07.number: The most numerous of all Master Physical Controllers (beyond reckoning in Satania alone); thirty divisions
roles: Function as living presence, pressure, and velocity gauges
Automatically and unerringly register the status of all force-energy
The chronoldeks also register time
The master frandalanks indicate the power pressure of a whole superuniverse

members.name: Frandalanks
members.note: Living gauges in thirty divisions, one for each form of basic universe force

members.name: Chronoldeks
members.note: Frandalanks that also register time; the master chronoldeks broadcast system time

g11.05.name: Master Force Organizers
g11.05.origin: Eventuated transcendental beings (neither creators nor creatures)
g11.05.realm: Resident on Paradise; active throughout the master universe, especially in unorganized outer space
roles: Work under the supervision of the Architects of the Master Universe
Transmute space potency into primordial force and initiate nebulae
Carry energy forward to the gravity-responding stage
Give way to the power directors when a Creator Son arrives

members.name: Primary Eventuated Master Force Organizers
members.note: Nebulae creators; transmute primordial force into primary or puissant energy

members.name: Associate Transcendental Master Force Organizers
members.note: Carry energy on to the secondary or gravity-energy stage; the Council of Equilibrium is drawn from their ranks

g12.title: The Personalities of the Grand Universe (The Seven Courtesy Colonies)
g12.intro: The courtesy colonies are seven groups of beings who sojourn as guests on the architectural spheres, from the local systems up to the superuniverse capitals, while they carry out their own missions and special assignments. They are not a single order created by one Deity; each colony gathers beings of many origins, and most of them are not organically part of the government of the world on which they reside. The seven are the star students, the celestial artisans, the reversion directors, the extension-school instructors, the various reserve corps, the student visitors, and the ascending pilgrims. This chapter takes them in turn, treating the celestial artisans, after Paper 44, in their seven divisions of activity.

g12.01.name: Star Students
g12.01.origin: A recruited group (any being from any world may join, given continuing life and sufficient knowledge of the worlds of space)
g12.01.realm: Uversa and the other superuniverse capitals, the sector headquarters, and the architectural capitals of the local universes and their subdivisions
g12.01.number: Over one million on Uversa alone
roles: Observe and calculate the stars and space
Study every form of space material and energy manifestation
Work with Solitary Messengers, reflective personalities, and energy transformers
Help the transport advisers work out routings
Stay as guests apart from superuniverse affairs, serving at least one millennium once admitted

g12.s02.title: Celestial Artisans
g12.s02.intro: The celestial artisans are the master artists and artisans of the morontia and lower spirit realms, a corps of composite personalities who are not created as such but selected and recruited. Their original teaching corps of seven thousand Havona instructors was assigned by the Infinite Spirit in collaboration with the Seven Master Spirits, and volunteer pupils from the ascending mortals and many celestial groups have joined them since. All are registered on the superuniverse headquarters, but they are commissioned in seven divisions and directed by the morontia supervisors of the local universe capitals; their chief realm of activity is the constellations.

g12.s02.01.name: Celestial Musicians
g12.s02.01.origin: Recruited celestial artisans (original teachers from Havona; pupils from ascending mortals and other celestial beings)
g12.s02.01.realm: The morontia and spirit worlds, especially the worlds around the constellation headquarters
g12.s02.01.number: Not revealed (the original teaching corps had 1,000 Havona instructors per division)
roles: Produce celestial harmony by manipulating spirit forces
Create melody in seven modes, from spiritual sound and light to color symphonies
Use over one hundred thousand modes of sound, color, and energy manipulation
Pick up the melodies of other spheres on the universe broadcast circuits

g12.s02.02.name: Heavenly Reproducers
g12.s02.02.realm: The morontia and spirit worlds (morontia conclaves and spirit assemblies)
roles: Reproduce past and present scenes and events on the morontia level
Combine memory recapitulation with mind rest alongside the reversion directors
Stage vast dramatic spectacles that portray the purpose of great assemblies
Serve the morontia education of the intellectual teachers and transition ministers

members.name: Singers
members.note: Reiterate past harmonies and interpret present melodies

members.name: Color Workers
members.note: Preserve passing scenes in light and shade

members.name: Light Picturizers
members.note: Make semispirit-phenomena preservations

members.name: Historic Pageanteers
members.note: Dramatically reproduce crucial events of universe history

members.name: Prophetic Artists
members.note: Project the meanings of history into the future

members.name: Life-story Tellers
members.note: Perpetuate the meaning of life experience

members.name: Administrative Enactors
members.note: Celestial dramatists of sovereignty and administration

g13.title: The Corps of the Finality
g13.intro: The Corps of the Finality is the present known destination of the ascending Adjuster-fused mortals of time: those who attain Paradise take the Trinity oath of eternity and are mustered into it. The primary, or mortal, corps is made up of six groups—Havona natives, Gravity Messengers, glorified mortals, adopted seraphim, glorified Material Sons, and glorified midway creatures—while the one remaining place in each company of a thousand is held by the chief of the attached Evangels of Light. The finaliters are a self-governing body that now returns to serve in the universes of time, but Uversa conjectures that their future destiny lies in the universes of outer space. This chapter treats the seven members of the mortal corps, followed by the Paradise Transcendentalers, whose chief administers the finaliter oath, and their governing corps, the Architects of the Master Universe.
g13.s01.title: The Primary Corps of the Finality
g13.s01.intro: The Primary Corps of the Finality, the mortal corps, is the primary finaliter corps, assembled on Paradise from the ascending beings of time and space. It is mobilized in companies of one thousand, of whom about 990 are usually ascendant mortals and adopted seraphim, while the remaining ten places go to the other members. The corps chooses its own leaders and swears allegiance only to the Paradise Trinity, and Grandfanda, the first mortal ascender, presides as the Paradise chief of all finaliters.

g13.s01.02.name: Gravity Messengers
g13.s01.02.origin: Divinington (modified and personalized Adjusters; a direct personalization of a fragment of the Universal Father)
g13.s01.02.realm: Attached to finaliter companies, transcending time and space (under Grandfanda's exclusive jurisdiction)
g13.s01.02.number: One chief mustered into each company (with a permanent staff of 999 fellows and unlimited reserves)

g13.s02.title: Paradise Transcendentalers
g13.s02.intro: The Transcendentalers are absonite beings who are neither creators nor creatures; they simply eventuate. They live in a vast area in the west of Paradise and are concerned with the superadministration of the master universe. They have nothing to do with the mortal ascent to Havona, yet mortal finaliters fraternize with them on Paradise, and the Trinity oath of eternity is administered to each new finaliter group by the chief of Transcendentalers. This section covers the Transcendentalers as a whole and their governing corps, the Architects of the Master Universe.

g14.title: The Personalities of the Local Universe
g14.intro: Paper 37 surveys the personalities of Nebadon who stand between the created Sons of God and the ministering spirits. Chief among them are the Universe Aids, seven orders ranging from Gabriel, the Bright and Morning Star, to the Mansion World Teachers, who assist in the administration, education, and ascension plan of the local universe. The paper then introduces the orders of permanent citizenship found at each administrative level—the susatia of Salvington, the univitatia of Edentia, the Material Sons of Jerusem, and the midway creatures of the evolutionary worlds—together with the abandonters of Uversa. It closes with two unusual orders at work on the architectural spheres, the spironga and the spornagia. Fourteen orders appear in this chapter; the Material Sons and the midway creatures receive their full treatment here.

g14.s01.intro: The Universe Aids are seven orders that assist in the administration of the local universe and in the ascension plan. Many orders belonging to this category remain unrevealed.
