g15.title: Ministering Spirits of the Local Universe
g15.intro: The ministering spirits of the local universe are the angelic corps made up of the seraphim, offspring of the Universe Mother Spirit, together with their assistants, the cherubim and sanobim. Seraphim have been projected in units of 41,472 at a time since the early days of Nebadon and are still being created; they are the most nearly standard of all spirit types, and they live in pairs. After education and testing they sort themselves into seven groups: supreme, superior, supervisor, and administrator seraphim, planetary helpers, transition ministers, and seraphim of the future, and every group except the last is divided again into seven subgroups. Cherubim and sanobim share the seraphic origin but are the lowest order of angels and the nearest of kin to human beings. The midway creatures, born on the inhabited worlds, are not angels proper, yet because they serve mortals alongside the angelic hosts they are functionally reckoned with the ministering spirits. This chapter takes up the seven seraphic groups and their subgroups, then the cherubim, sanobim, and midway creatures.

g15.s01.intro: The supreme seraphim are the highest of the seven revealed orders of local universe angels. They work in seven groups, each closely tied to the angelic ministers of the Seraphic Corps of Completion. Manotia, who helped prepare the paper on the seraphic orders, began as a supreme seraphim, and the Creator Son's fourth creature bestowal was made in the likeness of a teaching counselor of this order.

g15.s02.intro: The superior seraphim are so named not because they are qualitatively superior to other angels but because they are in charge of the higher activities of a local universe, centering on Salvington. roles: Act as the true mercy ministers of the local universe
Foster the higher impulses and holier emotions of men and angels
Are led by completion seraphim who were once guardians of mortal destiny
Include many who once served as justice guides

g15.s02.03.name: Spirit Co-ordinators
g15.s02.03.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as superior seraphim)
g15.s02.03.realm: Based on Salvington; serve anywhere in the local universe
roles: Prepare ascenders for the transition from morontia to spirit status
Teach morontia graduates to use the newly attained spirit mind
Serve ascending mortals in many other ways

g15.s02.04.name: Assistant Teachers
g15.s02.04.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as superior seraphim)
g15.s02.04.realm: The educational enterprises of the local universe, especially the mansion worlds; a corps also serves on Urantia
roles: Help and work alongside the teaching counselors
Take part in the sevenfold training scheme of the mansion worlds
Foster the cause of truth and righteousness on Urantia

g15.s02.05.name: Transporters
g15.s02.05.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as superior seraphim)
g15.s02.05.realm: Salvington; routes to and from the local universe headquarters
roles: Serve as space traversers to and from the universe headquarters
Carry, enseraphimed, personalities unable to travel by themselves
Induce transit sleep in liaison with Thought Adjusters
Cannot transport bodies of flesh and blood

g15.s02.06.name: Recorders
g15.s02.06.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as superior seraphim)
roles: Receive, file, and redispatch the records of Salvington
Serve as clerks of the Salvington courts and secretaries to its rulers
Keep contact with superuniverse, Havona, and Paradise recorders

members.name: Broadcasters
members.note: Receivers and dispatchers; a specialized subdivision handling the dispatch of records and essential information (144,000 simultaneous messages)

g15.s02.07.name: Reserves
g15.s02.07.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as superior seraphim)
roles: Stand by on Salvington for instant dispatch anywhere in Nebadon
Respond to directors of assignment and universe administrators
Furnish messenger aids to the chief of the Brilliant Evening Stars

g15.s03.title: Supervisor Seraphim
g15.s03.intro: The supervisor seraphim, the third order of local universe angels, are assigned exclusively to the service of the constellations. Headquartered on the constellation capitals, they minister widely to the surrounding morontia training worlds and work throughout Nebadon on behalf of their assigned realms.

g15.s03.01.name: Supervising Assistants
g15.s03.01.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as supervisor seraphim)
roles: Serve the collective work of the Constellation Fathers
Act as ever-efficient helpers of the Most Highs
Work for the unification and stabilization of the constellation

g15.s03.02.name: Law Forecasters
g15.s03.02.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as supervisor seraphim)
g15.s03.02.realm: The legislative assemblies of the constellations
roles: Forecast how proposed laws would affect freewill creatures
Speak before the lawmakers for those who cannot be present
Portray the true longings of the inner mortal soul
Seek no special favors for any group

g15.s03.03.name: Social Architects
g15.s03.03.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as supervisor seraphim)
g15.s03.03.realm: From individual planets through the mansion worlds to the seventy morontia progress worlds of Edentia (organized there in seventy divisions)
roles: Enhance sincere social contacts and further social evolution
Strip creature associations of artificiality
Bring suitable individuals together into effective working groups
Have jurisdiction over morontia undertakings involving three or more persons

g15.s03.04.name: Ethical Sensitizers
g15.s03.04.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as supervisor seraphim)
g15.s03.04.realm: Wherever they can serve, especially the brotherhood schools on Edentia
roles: Foster appreciation of the morality of interpersonal relationships
Serve as volunteer counselors to planetary rulers
Teach as exchange teachers on the system training worlds
Quicken the truths of fraternity in the Edentia brotherhood schools

g15.s03.05.name: Transporters
g15.s03.05.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as supervisor seraphim)
g15.s03.05.realm: Routes to and from the constellation headquarters
roles: Carry personalities to and from constellation headquarters
Stay fully aware of velocity, direction, and position in flight
Combine three energy lines to average 555,000 to 559,000 miles per second
Can change speed, course, or destination on instruction

g15.s03.06.name: Recorders
g15.s03.06.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as supervisor seraphim)
g15.s03.06.realm: Constellation headquarters, such as Edentia of Norlatiadek
roles: Act as special recorders of constellation affairs
Maintain a large and efficient corps on Edentia

g15.s03.07.name: Reserves
g15.s03.07.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as supervisor seraphim)
roles: Serve as messenger aids to the constellation rulers
Attach to the Salvington reserves of unassigned Vorondadeks
Attach to Vorondadeks on special assignment, such as Urantia's observer

g15.s04.title: Administrator Seraphim
g15.s04.intro: The administrator seraphim, the fourth order, are assigned to the administrative duties of the local systems. Native to the system capitals, they are also stationed in large numbers on the mansion and morontia spheres and the inhabited worlds, and they are endowed by nature with unusual administrative ability. Because the head of the seraphic hosts joined Lucifer, an unusually large number of this order went astray in Satania.

g15.s04.01.name: Administrative Assistants
g15.s04.01.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as administrator seraphim)
g15.s04.01.realm: System headquarters and the governments of the Planetary Princes; on Urantia, with the acting ruler
g15.s04.01.number: Not revealed (a corps of one thousand assists Urantia's acting ruler)
roles: Serve as immediate assistants of the System Sovereign
Travel the system as personal agents of its rulers
Attach to the governments of the Planetary Princes
Assist Melchizedek receivers and their successors after a Prince's defection

g15.s04.02.name: Justice Guides
g15.s04.02.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as administrator seraphim)
g15.s04.02.realm: System and planetary tribunals, including the conciliating commissions
roles: Present summaries of evidence in cases before the tribunals
Prepare statements for preliminary hearings on mortal survival
Prepare the defense in every case of doubtful survival
Ensure that justice is dealt out with generous mercy

g15.s04.03.name: Interpreters of Cosmic Citizenship
g15.s04.03.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as administrator seraphim)
g15.s04.03.realm: The system capitals, such as Jerusem, and the inhabited worlds
roles: Guide the new citizens of the system capitals
Quicken their sense of the responsibilities of universe government
Work with the Material Sons in system administration
Portray the duties of cosmic citizenship to mortals on the inhabited worlds

g15.s04.04.name: Quickeners of Morality
g15.s04.04.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as administrator seraphim)
g15.s04.04.realm: System headquarters and the inhabited worlds
roles: Quicken appreciation of cosmic morality, the interplay of liberty and loyalty
Teach the fruitfulness of patience and gradual progress
Portray mortal life as an unbroken chain of many links
Encourage spiritual advance through decision upon decision

g15.s04.05.name: Transporters
g15.s04.05.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as administrator seraphim)
g15.s04.05.realm: The local systems; in Satania, between Jerusem and the planets
roles: Carry passengers to and from Jerusem
Serve as interplanetary transporters within the system
Carry ascenders on to Edentia after their Jerusem assignment
Never carry a mortal back to his native planet

g15.s04.06.name: Recorders
g15.s04.06.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as administrator seraphim)
g15.s04.06.realm: The temple of records on the system capital, such as Jerusem
roles: Keep the threefold records of the local systems
Preside over the material, morontia, and spirit sections of the temple of records
Preserve all records in triplicate

g15.s04.07.name: Reserves
g15.s04.07.origin: The Universe Mother Spirit (classified as administrator seraphim)
g15.s04.07.realm: The system capital, such as Jerusem
roles: Wait on Jerusem for assignment
Serve as spirit companions to newly arrived ascending mortals
Share their wide experience with ascenders in friendly visits

g15.s05.title: Planetary Helpers
g15.s05.intro: The fifth order of seraphim, headquartered on the system capitals, accompanies the Planetary Adams and Eves on their world missions; the initial corps usually numbers about one hundred thousand. On Urantia most were withdrawn when the Adamic regime collapsed, and seraphic supervision fell more heavily on the administrators, the transition ministers, and the guardians of destiny. The destiny guardians, who watch over individual mortals, are drawn from all seraphic orders but serve on the planets, so they are included here.

g15.s05.01.name: Voices of the Garden
g15.s05.01.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (fifth order of seraphim, the planetary helpers)
g15.s05.01.realm: The Garden of Eden, headquarters of the Planetary Adam and Eve
roles: Serve as the personal seraphim of the Adam and Eve
Assist all projects for the physical and intellectual upstepping of the races
Remonstrate when the Adam departs from the ordained plan
On Urantia, some remained to serve Adam's successors in authority

members.name: Solonia
members.note: Chief of the planetary helpers in Adam's day on Urantia; proclaimed the miscarriage of the divine plan

g15.s05.02.name: Spirits of Brotherhood
g15.s05.02.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (fifth order of seraphim, the planetary helpers)
g15.s05.02.realm: Evolutionary worlds under the Adamic regime
roles: Foster racial harmony and social co-operation among diverse races
Help primitive men realize the wisdom of peaceful interassociation
Support the Material Sons in harmonizing and advancing the races

g15.s05.03.name: Souls of Peace
g15.s05.03.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (fifth order of seraphim, the planetary helpers)
g15.s05.03.realm: Evolutionary worlds under the Adamic regime
roles: Bring "peace on earth" to struggling worlds
In advanced ages, supplant the atonement idea with divine attunement
Their chief, Vevona, heralded the birth of Michael

members.name: Vevona
members.note: Chief of the souls of peace in Adam's day; now attached to the staff of the resident governor general

g15.s05.04.name: Spirits of Trust
g15.s05.04.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (fifth order of seraphim, the planetary helpers)
g15.s05.04.realm: Evolutionary worlds under the Adamic regime (on Urantia the whole group transferred to the new regime)
roles: Inculcate trust into the suspicious minds of primitive men
Nurture a civilization embodying ideals of confidence and trust
Teach that uncertainty is the secret of contented continuity

g15.s05.05.name: Transporters
g15.s05.05.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (fifth order of seraphim, the planetary helpers)
g15.s05.05.realm: The individual planets (many stationed on Urantia)
roles: Carry beings from the planet to the system capital (Urantia to Jerusem)
Enseraphim passengers asleep in the transit sleep
Shield passengers with energy insulators mistaken for wings
Depart from the spiritual headquarters, usually at midnight

g15.s05.06.name: Recorders
g15.s05.06.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (fifth order of seraphim, the planetary helpers)
roles: Record the major affairs of the planet as related to the system and universe government
Do not handle matters of individual life and existence

g15.s05.07.name: Reserves
g15.s05.07.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (fifth order of seraphim, the planetary helpers)
g15.s05.07.realm: Jerusem, in close association with the reserves of the Material Sons
roles: Provide for every phase of this order's activities
Serve as personal message bearers of the local systems
Serve transition mortals, angels, and Material Sons at the system headquarters
Frequently visit even isolated Urantia

g15.s05.08.name: Guardians of Destiny
g15.s05.08.origin: Experienced, volunteering seraphic pairs drawn from all orders of seraphim
g15.s05.08.realm: Beside individual mortals on the evolutionary worlds, accompanying them through the mansion worlds and beyond
roles: Guard mortals who make the supreme decision, enter the third circle, or join a reserve corps of destiny
Serve in pairs for the remainder of the mortal's life
The complemental seraphim keeps the mortal's record
Take part in personality reassembly in the resurrection halls
May pass through Seraphington into the Mortal Finaliter Corps

members.name: Group guardians
members.note: Seventh to fourth circles: one seraphic pair with cherubim watches over 1,000, 500, 100, or 10 mortals

members.name: Personal guardians
members.note: Third circle and above, supreme decision, or reserve corps of destiny: one pair for one mortal

g15.s06.title: Transition Ministers
g15.s06.intro: The sixth order of seraphim serves wherever creatures pass from the material to the spiritual estate. They work from the inhabited worlds to the system capitals, but in Satania they chiefly educate surviving mortals on the seven mansion worlds; their home is the sixth circle on Jerusem. Next to the destiny guardians, they are the seraphim who draw nearest to humans.

g15.s06.01.name: Seraphic Evangels
g15.s06.01.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (sixth order of seraphim, the transition ministers)
roles: Help ascenders choose among optional routes to Edentia, Salvington, Uversa, and Havona
Recommend each ascender's course to the four and twenty advisers on Jerusem
Proclaim the gospel of eternal progression and perfection attainment
Teach that no act of good is ever wholly lost

g15.s06.02.name: Racial Interpreters
g15.s06.02.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (sixth order of seraphim, the transition ministers)
g15.s06.02.realm: The worlds of time and the mansion worlds
roles: Further the race commissioners' efforts to harmonize racial viewpoints
Continue harmonizing lingering racial differences on the mansion worlds
Serve as sociologists and ethnic advisers of the first heaven

g15.s06.03.name: Mind Planners
g15.s06.03.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (sixth order of seraphim, the transition ministers)
roles: Group morontia beings effectively and organize their teamwork
Study the nature, experience, and status of souls in transit
Respect the newborn morontia will while encouraging progress
Most have prior experience as guardian angels

g15.s06.04.name: Morontia Counselors
g15.s06.04.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (sixth order of seraphim, the transition ministers)
g15.s06.04.realm: The mansion worlds, on the way to the system headquarters schools
roles: Teach, direct, and counsel surviving mortals
Teach the integration of meanings and unification of values (mota)
Help bring material and morontial viewpoints into true focus

g15.s06.05.name: Technicians
g15.s06.05.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (sixth order of seraphim, the transition ministers)
roles: Help new ascenders adjust to the strange morontia environment
Act as liaisons with Morontia Power Supervisors and Master Physical Controllers
Instruct ascenders about the energies used on the transition spheres
Serve as emergency space traversers

g15.s06.06.name: Recorder-Teachers
g15.s06.06.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (sixth order of seraphim, the transition ministers)
g15.s06.06.realm: The mansion worlds and the system headquarters
roles: Record the borderland transactions of the spiritual and the physical
Record the relationships of men and angels and morontia transactions
Teach efficient techniques of fact recording
Lead students to seek truth as well as fact

g15.s06.07.name: Ministering Reserves
g15.s06.07.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (sixth order of seraphim, the transition ministers)
roles: Stand by as reserves of all orders of transition seraphim
Volunteer to serve ascenders when unassigned
Kindle the will-to-service through personal friendship
Teach how to bear disappointment and leave the self out

g15.s07.title: Seraphim of the Future
g15.s07.intro: The seventh order of seraphim. Because they are not now directly concerned with Urantia, little of their activity is revealed.

g15.s07.01.name: Seraphim of the Future
g15.s07.01.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (seventh order of seraphim)
g15.s07.01.realm: Older realms and advanced planets; many held in reserve on the seraphic worlds near Salvington
roles: Prepare for the dawning of the age of light and life in Nebadon
Minister to mortals who survive by modified orders of ascension
Their activities are withheld, as they do not now concern Urantia

g15.s08.title: Cherubim, Sanobim and Midway Creatures
g15.s08.intro: Cherubim and sanobim share the seraphim's origin and form the lowest order of angels, assisting all seven seraphic orders. They work in pairs and are almost human. The midway creatures are not angels but are functionally grouped with them.

g15.s08.01.name: Cherubim
g15.s08.01.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (same origin as seraphim)
g15.s08.01.realm: The individual worlds of the systems and the morontia training worlds (serve only within the local universe)
roles: Serve as subordinate assistants to all seven orders of seraphim
Work as routine spirit workers on the individual worlds
Pair with sanobim as the positive, right-hand deflector
Keep the records of the seraphic guardians
May advance through embrace to Mansion World Teachers, even to seraphim

members.name: Ascension Candidates
members.note: Natural candidates for seraphic status; may attain full seraphic standing

members.name: Mid-phase Cherubim
members.note: Limited in ascension potential; most remain cherubim and sanobim

members.name: Morontia Cherubim
members.note: The quasi-material "fourth creatures" (one in four); perform borderline tasks on the morontia worlds

g15.s08.02.name: Sanobim
g15.s08.02.origin: The local universe Mother Spirit (same origin as seraphim)
g15.s08.02.realm: The individual worlds of the systems and the morontia training worlds (serve only within the local universe)
roles: Serve as the cherubim's partner, the negative left-hand deflector
Act as the "complement of being" to the cherubim
Limited when alone, so usually work paired with a cherubim
Help keep records together with the cherubim
Share the cherubim's path of advancement to Mansion World Teachers and seraphim

g15.s08.03.name: Midway Creatures
g15.s08.03.note: Primary and secondary midwayers, native to the inhabited worlds. Not angels proper, they are functionally reckoned with the ministering spirits of time. Treated in full in Chapter 14.

g16.title: The Ascending Sons of God
g16.intro: Paper 40 presents the seven general classes of the Ascending Sons of God—beings who begin on lower levels and rise through experience and service to higher spiritual status. They range from the lowly animal-origin mortals of the evolutionary worlds to the Personalized Adjusters of the Universal Father. Mortals are classified by the spirit with which they fuse: Father-fused, Son-fused, or Spirit-fused, and their destinies differ accordingly—Paradise, the superuniverse, or the local universe. To these are added the nonmortal ascending orders: evolutionary seraphim, ascending Material Sons, translated midwayers, and Personalized Adjusters. Seven orders appear in this chapter.

g16.01.name: Father-fused Mortals
g16.01.origin: Animal-origin mortals of the evolutionary worlds who fuse with their indwelling Thought Adjusters
g16.01.realm: From the evolutionary worlds through the mansion worlds, superuniverse, and Havona to Paradise
roles: Usually fuse with their Adjusters on the mansion worlds
Traverse the Havona circuits and find God on Paradise
Are mustered into the Corps of Mortal Finality
Have the career of universal service wide open before them

members.name: One-brained type
members.note: Of Adjuster-fusion potential

members.name: Two-brained type
members.note: The intermediate type to which Urantians belong

members.name: Three-brained type
members.note: From the system headquarters on, all three progress alike

g16.02.name: Son-fused Mortals
g16.02.origin: Ascending mortals who fail to achieve Adjuster fusion and are fused with an individualized gift of the spirit of the Creator Son
g16.02.realm: The superuniverse (Orvonton); some attain residential status on Uversa
g16.02.number: Less than one million in Orvonton
roles: Share the services of Orvonton with their Adjuster-fused brethren
Supervise the routine work of the abandonters on Uversa
Contribute accumulated wisdom to the settlement of the superuniverse

g16.03.name: Spirit-fused Mortals
g16.03.origin: Mortals who are not Adjuster-fusion candidates, fused on the mansion worlds with an individualization of the spirit of the local universe Mother Spirit
g16.03.realm: The local universe; in Nebadon their home is the eighth group of worlds encircling Salvington
g16.03.number: Not numerous, at least in Nebadon
roles: Serve as permanent citizens of the local universe
Interpret mortal viewpoints as High Commissioners
Serve the local universe with the susatia of Salvington
May be transformed to ascend to the superuniverse when needed

g16.04.name: Evolutionary Seraphim
g16.04.origin: Local universe seraphim who achieve ascendant sonship through experience and service with ascending mortals
g16.04.realm: They ascend with mortals and pass through Seraphington, the angelic destiny sphere, to Paradise
roles: Accompany mortals as guardians of destiny
Advance by study in the extension schools of the mansion worlds
Gain parenthood experience helping rear Adamic children on Jerusem
Many are mustered into the Corps of Mortal Finality

g16.05.name: Ascending Material Sons
g16.05.origin: Material Sons and Daughters, originally descending Sons, who register as ascending Sons after their mission or by withdrawing from system citizenship
g16.05.realm: From an evolutionary world or the system capital to Havona and Paradise
roles: Resign planetary duties once their world is settled in light and life
Register as perfected Material Sons in the local universe records
Ascend to Paradise in company with mortals
Attain the Corps of Mortal Finality

g16.06.name: Translated Midwayers
g16.06.origin: Primary and secondary midway creatures released from planetary service
g16.06.realm: From their native planet through the morontia worlds, superuniverse, and Havona to Paradise
roles: Are released from planetary duty about the intermediate epochs of light and life
Are registered in the local universe as ascending Sons
Ascend to Paradise by the same routes as mortals
Primary go to various finaliter corps; secondary to the Mortal Corps

g16.07.name: Personalized Adjusters
g16.07.origin: Experienced Thought Adjusters personalized by the Universal Father, such as those who indwelt incarnated bestowal Sons or served with unusual distinction
g16.07.realm: At home on Divinington; active throughout the universe of universes
roles: Instruct and direct their prepersonal associates on Divinington
Act as sovereign stabilizers and compensators of the universes
Serve as executives of the Architects of the Master Universe
Minister in the extraordinary and the unexpected

g17.title: Not Classified
g17.intro: The Urantia Book leaves a few beings outside its general classifications of personality. After describing the seven broad classes of evolutionary creature life, it notes that even these make no provision for such beings as the midsoniters. This chapter gathers two such groups: the midsoniters, offspring of a Melchizedek life carrier and a Material Daughter, who can hardly be reckoned either mortal or immortal; and the agondonters, the functional grouping of ascenders from worlds isolated by rebellion.

g17.01.name: Midsoniters
g17.01.origin: Offspring of a materially modified Melchizedek life carrier and a volunteer Material Daughter (the Mother Eve)
g17.01.realm: The one midsonite world in each local system; later the Salvington midsonite sphere, seventh of the finaliters' worlds
g17.01.number: Not revealed (every midsoniter ever born in Nebadon is alive today)
roles: Live as reproducing beings on their native worlds until a thousand standard years of age
Are then translated by seraphic transport and no longer reproduce
Forgather on the Salvington midsonite sphere for some unrevealed future eventuality
Counsel legislative assemblies and tribunals in the age of light and life
Sponsor teaching enterprises jointly with the finaliters

g17.02.name: Agondonters
g17.02.origin: Evolutionary mortal ascenders from worlds isolated in consequence of rebellion
g17.02.realm: A residential sector of their own on Jerusem; they remain grouped through the local universe and superuniverse ascent, and again on Paradise and in the Corps of the Mortal Finality
roles: Believe without seeing and persevere when isolated
Triumph over insuperable difficulties even when alone
Remain a functional group throughout the ascent (except during the Havona sojourn)
Are entrusted early with special cosmic assignments that demand faith and confidence

members.name: Tabamantia
members.note: An agondonter of finaliter status, a survivor from a sphere quarantined in the first rebellion
